name: Question 16
problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A$, where

$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}3{y}^{2},\, & \text{if}\,1<x<9,\,-1<y<1, \\ \frac{1}{4\sqrt{xy}},\, & \text{if}\,1<x<9,\,1<y<4,\end{aligned}
$$

and  $R$ is the domain of $f.$

EXPLANATION

First, notice that we have R=R1∪R2, where R1=(1,9)×(−1,1) and R2=(1,9)×(1,4). So, we can write

∬Rf(x,y)dA==∬R1f(x,y)dA+∬R2f(x,y)dA=∬R13y2dA+∬R214xydA=∬R13y2dA+∬R2(12x)(12y)dA=(9−1)∫−113y2dy+(∫1912xdx)(∫1412ydy)=8[y3]−11+[x]19⋅[y]14=8(13−(−1)3)+(3−1)⋅(2−1)=18.
